mapper.sql: release.id, release.tenant_id, release.application_id, release.version_no, release.source_release_id, release.request_id, release.operation, release.application_type, release.application_name, release.description, release.model_config_id, release.system_prompt, release.knowledge_base_ids_json::text AS knowledge_base_ids_json, release.tool_ids_json::text AS tool_ids_json, release.owner_user_ids_json::text AS owner_user_ids_json, release.allowed_user_ids_json::text AS allowed_user_ids_json, release.application_created_at, release.published_by, release.reason, release.trace_id, release.published_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_application_release ( id, tenant_id, application_id, version_no, source_release_id, request_id, operation, application_type, application_name, description, model_config_id, system_prompt, knowledge_base_ids_json, tool_ids_json, owner_user_ids_json, allowed_user_ids_json, application_created_at, published_by, reason, trace_id, published_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{tenantId}, #{applicationId}, #{versionNo}, #{sourceReleaseId}, #{requestId}, #{operation}, #{applicationType}, #{applicationName}, #{description}, #{modelConfigId}, #{systemPrompt}, CAST(#{knowledgeBaseIdsJson} AS JSONB), CAST(#{toolIdsJson} AS JSONB), CAST(#{ownerUserIdsJson} AS JSONB), CAST(#{allowedUserIdsJson} AS JSONB), #{applicationCreatedAt}, #{publishedBy}, #{reason}, #{traceId}, #{publishedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE app_application SET status = 'ACTIVE', published_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now}, updated_by = #{actorId}, version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{applicationId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT FROM app_application_release release JOIN app_application_active_release active ON active.tenant_id = release.tenant_id AND active.application_id = release.application_id AND active.active_release_id = release.id WHERE release.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND release.application_id = #{applicationId} LIMIT 1
